directions.name: 1 Le Toit a bout de bras

prompts.rough: A lean-to shed of crooked weathered planks with a sloping plank roof made from a salvaged door, one corner of the roof resting on nothing. Under that corner a stocky bearded smith in a plain brown leather apron lies on his back on a plank between two dark barrels and presses the roof corner up with both arms straight, he is the corner post. Scrap wood, rope, a small lantern under the roof, two spears leaning on the back wall. Matte dull iron, no shine, no gilding, no forge, no anvil, no fire, no hanging cloth. Only one figure, large and sharp. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter view from above.
prompts.grand: A squat stone hall with a wide roof of rust-red tiles and two small dormers, lifted clear of the walls by a visible gap of about one man's height. The roof is held up by two short thick bent oak arms, one on each side, elbows bent outward, plain wood with iron bands, no hands and no feet, no fingers, just stubby bent beams. Through the gap under the roof one sees a bench, and the stocky bearded smith in a brown apron lying on it pressing upward with both hands. A weapon rack with a few dented matte grey iron pieces, nothing shiny. A red banner stretched on a rigid frame, no hanging cloth. Dark oak, grey stone. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter view from above.
prompts.mythic: A big stone hall with a huge slate and rust-tile roof carrying a full upper storey with dormers, gallery and one small chimney, the roof almost twice as wide as the walls, raised very high above them on two short thick bent oak arms with blackened matte iron bands, elbows bent outward, one on each side. The arms are plain stubby beams, no hands, no feet, no fingers, not a house on legs, not a creature. Under the roof is an empty gap taller than the walls, where the stocky bearded smith in a brown apron lies on a bench, clearly visible. A small roofer sits astride the ridge of the roof with arms up. Matte dull grey iron, dark oak, grey stone, small touches of dark red on rigid framed banners, no shine, no gilding, no hanging cloth. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter view from above.

prompts.rough: A low plank shed. In front of it a thick knotty rough tree trunk lies across two planted wooden forks, a patched cart wheel at each end, the trunk longer than the shed. The stocky bearded smith in a plain tunic lies on a plank under it and pushes up, the trunk bends slightly. A small lantern hangs from one fork. Raw wood, rope, no metal shine, no cord or rope hanging under the trunk, no gallows. Only one or two large sharp figures. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter view from above.
prompts.grand: A squat grey stone hall with rust-red tiles. Two tall stocky stone pillars rise above its roof, one at each side, and a knotty oak trunk rests across them above the hall. The trunk bends sharply downward in the middle, a clear strong curve, drawn in solid dark wood. At each end hang stacks of at most three rough raw dark wooden shields, set on edge, uneven, irregular, no pale round discs, no emblem, no metal rim, matte. Nothing hangs under the trunk, no rope, no gallows. In front the stocky bearded smith in a brown apron rubs chalk on his hands next to a single-slab stone bench. Dull matte grey, no shine, no gilding. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter view from above.
prompts.mythic: A grey stone armory hall with rust-red tiles and one small chimney, clearly visible, standing behind and between two very tall squat stone pillars, so the building is the main mass of the picture. A whole oak tree trunk lies across the pillars above the hall and bends frankly, deeply sagging, the middle clearly lower than the ends, solid dark wood. At each end of the trunk lies a stack of three rough raw dark brown wooden shields set on edge, uneven slabs, not pale, not round discs, no emblem, no metal rim. Nothing hangs under the trunk, no rope, no gallows, no hanging cloth, no banners, not a doorway, not a table. A small dented empty suit of dull dark grey matte armor, like old soot-black iron, no polished steel, no shine, no gilding, holds the trunk up with one hand, helmet under its other arm, standing on the ground. Seen from a three-quarter view from above, no cast shadow painted on the ground, a small feathered patch of ground, no hard-edged diamond slab.

prompts.rough: A simple wooden shack, open on the front, with a rough rack of plain swords and spears and a few round wooden shields, a smith checking a blade. A believable real medieval building, weathered and lived in, no joke, no cartoon proportions. A small feathered patch of natural ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no smoke haze. Figures large and clear, no hanging cloth.
prompts.grand: A solid timber and stone armory with a wide open door, racks of swords and spears on the walls, rows of shields, helmets on pegs, a suit of plain mail on a wooden stand. A believable real medieval building, weathered and lived in, no joke, no cartoon proportions. A small feathered patch of natural ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no smoke haze. Figures large and clear, no hanging cloth.
prompts.mythic: A great stone armory, its huge front open like a cutaway, and the tall walls inside are covered with many legendary suits of masterwork armour on stands, engraved dark steel and matte bronze, great shields and extraordinary weapons in rows. Incredible and imposing, no glow, no shine. A believable real medieval building, weathered and lived in, no joke, no cartoon proportions. A small feathered patch of natural ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no smoke haze. Figures large and clear, no hanging cloth.
